description: Post to a discussion inside a group workspace. Visible to your groupmates and instructors. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true. Apps that can ask the user directly will show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

group_id.description: Student group ID (numeric string). Get it from list_my_groups.

message.description: Message text. Plain text or simple HTML.

topic_id.description: Discussion topic ID (numeric string). Get it from list_topics.

name: post_group_discussion
title: Post Group Discussion
